name: camera_bump_amplifies_pinch_contact
hypothesis: The 20 mm camera translation already produced 46.8 N during pinch approach. Adding a small pitch error changes the reconstructed rim position further while potentially preserving the accepted radius, causing the position-controlled hand to drive into the plate before grasping.
expected_failure: Step 5 pinch approach produces an unplanned contact above 50 N, potentially before its held-plate check detects any problem.
real_world_story: Someone knocks the camera bracket while cleaning, shifting and tilting it slightly.
